name: Seers
summary: Seers Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in delivering remote healthcare solutions, particularly those involving patient surveillance. The company's diverse product range features wearable biosensors, comprehensive central patient monitoring systems, medical artificial intelligence (AI) applications, and specialized medical adhesive materials. Young-Shin Lee established this enterprise on August 11, 2009, and its corporate headquarters are located in Pyeongtaek-si, South Korea.
